sentence_en: Due to the threat of erosion, it is unsafe to build on the land.
sentence_zh: 由于存在侵蚀的威胁，在这片土地上建造是不安全的。

sentence_en: Deforestation is one of the consequences of our expanding urban areas.
sentence_zh: 滥伐森林是我们城市区域不断扩张带来的后果之一。

sentence_en: The government is considering placing a tax on the carbon emissions of each company.
sentence_zh: 政府正在考虑对每家公司的碳排放征税。

sentence_en: Tomatoes that are grown in greenhouses are able to survive through the winter months.
sentence_zh: 在温室里种植的西红柿能够熬过冬季的几个月。

sentence_en: Most of the carbon emissions are caused by burning fossil fuels such as coal and oil.
sentence_zh: 大部分碳排放是由燃烧煤和石油等化石燃料造成的。

sentence_en: The blaze from the bushfire was so hot and intense it burnt everything that stood in its path.
sentence_zh: 丛林大火的火势如此炽热猛烈，烧毁了沿途的一切。

sentence_en: The spark from the engine caused a conflagration that destroyed almost half of the forest.
sentence_zh: 发动机迸出的火花引发了一场大火，烧毁了近一半的森林。
